verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a SaaS notarization and incorporation service, and such a service could plausibly ship an official CLI, so this axis applies. The evidence documents only a REST API, webhooks and llms.txt files. Nothing mentions an official command-line tool, and the REST API is a developer building block, not a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
